item.title: 🍽 HUB1 - Sprout Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB1 - Sprout Lunch Menu: A selection of fresh seasonal vegetables that you can combine with a protein of your choice to create your own meal salad.

item.title: 🍽 HUB1 - Homebound Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB1 - Homebound Lunch Menu: Oven-baked dab with lemon and rosemary. Served with creamy herb sauce, garlic-fried green beans, roasted potatoes and cucumber salad with dill on the side.

item.title: 🍽 HUB1 - Globetrotter Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB1 - Globetrotter Lunch Menu: Pork Guisantes, Filipino pork stew, with Sinangag, garlic fried rice. Served with Saging na Saba, fried plantain, and a fresh green salad on the side. GREEN DISH: Dish Tofu Guisantes, Filipino tofu stew, with Sinangag, garlic fried rice. Served with Saging na Saba, fried plantain, and a fresh green salad on the side.

item.title: 🍽 HUB3 - Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB3 - Lunch Menu: The American-Italian classic, pasta chicken alfredo. (1+6+15) GREEN DISH: Dish Pasta alfredo with butter beans. (1+6+15)

item.title: 🍽 HUB2 - Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB2 - Lunch Menu: Chicken tikka masala, a flavourful and intense Indian classic. (6+15) GREEN DISH: Dish No chicken tikka masala, a flavourful and intense Indian classic. (6+15)

item.title: 🍽 HUB1 – Kays - Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB1 – Kays - Lunch Menu: Spanish spiced pork neck with Canarian wrinkled potatoes, topped with garlic-fried green beans. Served with mojo verde, mojo rojo and tomato salad with red onion and olive oil. The dish is gluten-free. (13+15) GREEN DISH: Dish Spanish spiced portobello mushroom with Canarian wrinkled potatoes, topped with garlic-fried green beans. Served with mojo verde, mojo rojo and tomato salad with red onion and olive oil. The dish is gluten-free and vegan. (13+15)
